The state of [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]], is administratively divided into 15 [[Mesoregions of Brazil|mesoregions]] which are further divided into 64 [[Microregions of Brazil|microregions]].<ref>{{in lang|pt}} [https://biblioteca.ibge.gov.br/visualizacao/monografias/GEBIS%20-%20RJ/DRB/Divisao%20regional_v01.pdf Territorial subdivision of Brazil]</ref> They are further divided into 645 [[Municipalities of Brazil|municipalities]].
